name: BuiltByIndies (SaaSSpace)

sources.title: Submit route — JS-rendered app shell; nav shows weekly Launchpad, Karma, Stories, Chat
SubmitMap walkthrough — free lane costs 10 karma and queues ~5 weeks out; Premium $9 one-time: pick the week, instant publish, dofollow; free tier links nofollow except week's top 3
Get Karma page — karma earned via milestones/upvotes (index snippet)

conditions: Free launch requires 10 karma earned by completing profile + upvoting other products; the free queue also fills weeks ahead (reported ~5 weeks out)
Premium $9 one-time bypasses karma and queue: pick any open week, instant publish, dofollow link
requirements: Indie SaaS/maker product — community launchpad for indie founders
Account required; submission is a weekly launch, not a static listing

Form completion meter must hit 100% before Submit Product enables (name ≤45 chars, URL, tagline ≤60, up to 3 categories, pricing model, optional collaborators/open-source flag, 'Built with', rich description ≤5000 chars, 500×500 logo, 3–4 covers 1200×630, optional demo video)
preparation: Tagline ≤60 chars and description ≤5000 chars — or use the 'Prefill with AI' feature (paste URL, it drafts the form)
Decide launch week strategy: grind 10 karma for free queue vs $9 premium
If going free: plan ~1 week of upvoting to earn karma, then expect several weeks of queue wait
workflow: Earn karma via Karma Center milestones (profile completion, upvotes) OR skip with $9 Premium
Fill the product form to 100% completion; Submit Product creates the product and opens /upgrade
Choose Free Launch (spend 10 karma, join queue, pick an open week) or Premium ($9, instant)
Launch runs during its weekly batch — rally upvotes; the week's top 3 get dofollow links
watchFor: Free links are nofollow per the plan card; only top-3 weekly products get dofollow — free tier is a visibility play, not SEO
Queue scarcity is real: free weeks can be booked 4–5 weeks out
Submit page is JS-only — must run in a real browser with an authenticated session
Karma must be claimed manually on the Karma Center per the third-party walkthrough
countsAsLive: The product has a page under builtbyindies.com/products/<slug> and appears in its launch week at /launch/<year>/week/<n> with vote count
unknowns: Current queue depth at any given time
Whether premium placements affect ranking fairness
Retention of listing after launch week ends
